column1: # Packages whose tests always run (go test -count=1), one per line: directory, a tab, the reason.
# Every other package of the root module uses Go's test cache. Go replays a result while the test
# binary, its flags, the environment variables the test read and the files it opened inside the
# module are unchanged (test/testcache/cmd/normalize-mtimes keeps checkout times from changing the key).
# A package whose tests depend on state the cache cannot see belongs here; test/testcache checks
# that no package that reads such state is missing.
